tagline: Pass the bomb. Solve the puzzle. Be the last brain standing.
description:
**PUZZLE RIVALS** is a neon-soaked competitive puzzle arena where every solve matters and every miss explodes.

Drop into **4-player Bomb FFA** — one player gets a lit bomb, a random puzzle appears, and the timer starts counting down. Solve it and toss the bomb to a rival. Miss the deadline and *boom* — you're out. Last brain standing wins.

Or go head-to-head in **Brain VS Brain** — two players, the same puzzle, parallel boards. Build points faster than your opponent and unleash sabotage attacks on their screen: shake their view, invert their controls, freeze their inputs, rescramble their puzzle. Fall behind and you accrue defensive moves — block, mirror, auto-solve a chunk, or claw back points.

Eleven distinct puzzle modes — Pipe Pulse, Circuit Scramble, Mirror Beam Mayhem, Maze Rush, Crystal Rush and more — keep every round feeling fresh. The puzzles get harder as the round drags on. Built for fast sessions, ruthless rivalries, and that satisfying *click* of a perfect solve.
